name: study4_cohort
title: Cardiology Outpatients with Non-Ischemic Dilated Cardiomyopathy and Reduced LVEF
description: This cohort includes all patients with non-ischemic DCM and a clinical encounter at the cardiology out-patient clinic, age >= 18 years. Patients are selected using an ICD-10 code based DCM definition: ICD-10 code (I42.0) and LVEF < 45% (measured using ultrasound only).

entry.name: patientEncounter
entry.description: Captures cardiology outpatient encounters (ambulatory class) for patients.

eligibility.name: adultDcmReducedEfCohort
eligibility.description: Selects adult patients (>=18 years at the time of encounter) with a non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy diagnosis (ICD-10 I42.0), with an LVEF below 45% measured by ultrasound only.

criteria.name: adult
criteria.description: Excludes patients younger than 18 years at the time of encounter.

criteria.name: dcm
criteria.description: Includes patients with a non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy diagnosis (ICD-10 I42.0) recorded during the outpatient encounter.

criteria.name: reducedEf
criteria.description: Includes patients with a left ventricular ejection fraction below 45%, measured by ultrasound only, during the outpatient encounter.
criteria.filter: component.where(code.coding.system='http://loinc.org' and (code.coding.code='79990-8' or code.coding.code='79992-4' or code.coding.code='79993-2' or code.coding.code='79991-6' or code.coding.code='77890-2' or code.coding.code='93644-3' or code.coding.code='93645-0' or code.coding.code='77891-0' or code.coding.code='18049-7')).valueQuantity.value < 45
